name: Personal Finance Planner
summary: An independent Excel workbook for understanding income, expenses, monthly financial activity and the bigger picture through an updating dashboard.
description: Track what comes in and what goes out, use drop-down menus when entering income and expenses, review monthly metrics that update with your entries, and build a history for future planning.
features: Monthly financial metrics that update as information is entered
Drop-down menus for income and expense tracking
Monthly and annual reviews plus assets, debts, and accounts
